displayAddress: Parisienne Hotel, 240-244 North Promenade, Blackpool, Lancashire, FY1 1RZ
description:
The property consists of a substantial 62 bedroom hotel within a three block five storey sea front property
occupying a prominent position in North Shore Blackpool. The hotel has not been trading for a number of years and 
requires extensive refurbishment which is reflected in the low asking price for a property of this size.  There are no trading accounts available.  There is a small car park to the front providing parking for 4 motor vehicles for guests. Small yard area to the rear.
keyFeatures: Substantial 3 block 5 storey 62 bedroom hotel (all en-suite).
Situated on the prestigious north promenade.
Currently not trading and in need of renovation.
